title: metamodel-submodelChangeEvent.v1
description: Metamodel-aligned schema for Submodel change events. Uses AAS Reference objects as defined in IDTA-01001.

Key.description: A single key within a Reference chain. Corresponds to Key in the AAS metamodel (IDTA-01001).

type.description: The model element type this key refers to.

value.description: The identifier or local ID of the referenced element.

Reference.description: A Reference as defined in the AAS metamodel (IDTA-01001). Can be an ExternalReference (e.g. IRI pointing to a standard) or a ModelReference (navigable path within an AAS repository).

type.description: Distinguishes between external references (e.g. IRDIs, IRIs) and model-internal references.

keys.description: Ordered sequence of keys forming the reference path.

referredSemanticId.description: Optional: semantic ID of the referenced element, used to distinguish elements with the same id-path but different semantics.

submodelId.description: Identifier of the submodel (URI). Corresponds to Submodel.id in the AAS metamodel.

semanticId.description: Semantic ID of the submodel as an AAS Reference object. Typically an ExternalReference with a GlobalReference key pointing to the IRI of the submodel template (e.g. an IDTA submodel specification). Optional, matching Submodel.semanticId cardinality 0..1 in the AAS metamodel: the field is omitted when the submodel carries no semantic ID.

globalAssetIds.description: Global identifiers of all assets this submodel belongs to. Corresponds to AssetInformation.globalAssetId. A submodel may be shared across multiple assets.
